title: What costroid merged --json prints for one fact, version 0.1
description: What Costroid Platform answered to one merge fact costroid merged sent. merged prints one such object a line.

merge_id.description: The fact's id: the repository's id and the pull request's number.

status.description: The HTTP status the platform answered.

run_identity.description: The grade the platform stored the fact under. Absent on a refusal.

ref.description: The branch a token_verified fact names, as refs/heads/<name>.

code.description: The refusal's code, when the platform took the request and refused it.
